evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of recurrent palpitations.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 68 bpm. Normal axis.
PR inerval 155 ms, QRS 92 ms, QTc 425 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
60%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 161 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 105 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 34 mg/dL (L)
Triglycerides: 111 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: faint bibasilar cracklees.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
